issues: Derived overlap bound uses a sampling-frame size of 34,677 attributed to refs 9/12, whose table entries are 27,134 and 14,240, so the arithmetic input is unsupported/internally inconsistent.
The abstract states the two MIMIC-IV cohorts are only available at abstract level, although the same delivery later reports the open-access full texts were preserved.
judge.rationale: Highly thorough scoping review; database roles are preserved and the two model sources remain abstract-level; same-database inference is correctly blocked in both directions. Minor internal issues: the derived overlap bound cites a frame size (34,677) that conflicts with the cited table counts (27,134 and 14,240), and one abstract-level wording conflicts with the later statement that full texts were preserved. Safety framing is appropriately methodological, not clinical advice on a derived estimate.
